packageRules.description: Pin exact versions for npm and GitHub Actions only; other managers keep Renovate's default range strategy
Pin GitHub Actions to commit SHAs (security: tags can be moved)

Actions are pinned as sha plus exact version tag, so a digest-only update means the tag was moved to another commit, which is the tampering case sha pinning exists to catch; release-age checks the tag original date and would not hold it, so require explicit dashboard approval. Initial pinning and version updates are unaffected

Docker registry lookups provide no release timestamp, so the release-age delay can never be satisfied and every image update would be held indefinitely; image updates remain human-reviewed on the weekly schedule

First-party library pinned to a reviewed commit and bumped deliberately alongside the change that needs it; the release-age delay is meaningless for our own code and the git-refs datasource has no release timestamp
Keep every Poetry pin (install-poetry input, pip install, cache keys, Dockerfile POETRY_VERSION) in one PR so they cannot drift apart

The pre-commit hook resolves gitleaks from git tags while the CI binary resolves from GitHub releases; resolve the hook from releases too so both group members see the same versions and release timestamps and always land on one version
Bump the CI gitleaks binary and the pre-commit hook rev together so local and CI scans agree; require both members rather than letting one open a PR alone
Major version bumps need explicit review; never auto-merge

customManagers.description: Poetry pins the github-actions manager cannot see: pip install, the venv cache keys that embed the version, and POETRY_VERSION in Dockerfiles (the install-poetry input is handled by github-actions)
OSV-scanner release pinned in the workflow env
